market_question: Will the No to ten million Switzerland initiative be approved in Switzerland’s June 14, 2026 popular vote?
reasoning: The 'No to 10 million' initiative seeks to cap Switzerland's population by suspending free movement, risking EU bilateral agreements. Historically, only ~10% of Swiss popular initiatives pass, and the 2020 similar Limitation Initiative was rejected 62-38. While the 2014 Mass Immigration passed narrowly, the more radical nature and lack of recent supportive polling make a 33.5% implied probability appear too high.
evidence_points: Only ~10% of Swiss popular initiatives have been approved since 1848.
The 2020 'Limitation Initiative' (ending free movement) was rejected by 61.7% of voters.
The initiative would require termination of the EU Free Movement Agreement, triggering a clash with the entire Bilateral I treaty package.
sources_consulted: Swiss Federal Chancellery overview of 2026 referenda
Media coverage of SVP immigration initiatives
